title: English Practice Quiz 0858
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Advanced Vocabulary: What does meticulous describe?
questions.explanation: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail.

questions.question: Advanced Vocabulary: What does feasible mean?
options: Practical and possible to carry out
questions.explanation: Feasible means capable of being done.

questions.question: Advanced Vocabulary: What does concise mean?
questions.explanation: Concise writing expresses ideas briefly and clearly.

questions.question: Advanced Vocabulary: What does mitigate mean?
questions.explanation: Mitigate means make something less severe.

questions.question: Advanced Vocabulary: What does provisional mean?
questions.explanation: Provisional means arranged for now but not final.

questions.question: Advanced Vocabulary: What does compelling mean?
Advanced Vocabulary: What is a discrepancy?
questions.explanation: A discrepancy is a mismatch or inconsistency.

questions.question: Advanced Vocabulary: What does scrutinise mean?
Advanced Vocabulary: What does redundant mean?
questions.explanation: Redundant means unnecessary because it is no longer needed.

questions.question: Advanced Vocabulary: What does impartial mean?
options: Fair and not favouring either side
